prompt: Ivy finds a lost puppy in the park
title: Lost Puppy
irony: Ivy hides the found puppy to keep it, but the puppy's loud bark finds the owner, so keeping means giving back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sun shines on the park swings while a small brown puppy naps under the slide.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Ivy spots the puppy and plans to keep it without reading the shiny tag.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox runs up and claims the puppy answers only to his whistle call.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Ivy lifts the puppy high and chants about the lost puppy with friends.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Ivy hides the puppy behind the slide and it barks at each passing pigeon.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The puppy tugs Knox's shorts down as Teddy recites puppy treat facts fast.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Ivy hugs the puppy close and repeats the lost puppy chant louder.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lou watches the thirsty puppy lap water and feels his tight chest loosen.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lou slides a free pancake to the puppy while Teddy reads the tag and Ivy finds the name.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Back on the street, Lou sings that keeping means giving the puppy home.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Ivy waves as the owner thanks Lou and walks home past the sunny swings.
